descriptionChirho: To position oneself beside or near someone, to stand in proximity to a person or place.
To come upon someone unexpectedly, to appear or present oneself suddenly before a person.
To be present or imminent as a state, describing something that has arrived and is now upon someone.
To come upon someone with hostile intent, to rush upon or assault aggressively.
To be persistent or ready, to press on with urgency in carrying out a duty.
